data.one_liner: Integrate Monaco Editor (VS Code) into Flutter apps via WebView.
data.what_it_does: Embeds the Monaco Editor into Flutter applications on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web. Supports 100+ languages, syntax highlighting, themes, multi-document editing, and Language Server Protocol (LSP).
use_when: You need a full-featured code or text editor inside your Flutter desktop, mobile, or web application.
You require syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, find/replace, or diff views for multiple languages.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-line text input field.
You are targeting Linux (Linux is not supported).
strengths: Brings the exact editor experience of VS Code to Flutter.
Supports over 100 languages, multiple themes, and Language Server Protocol (LSP).
Works across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Web.
weaknesses: Relies on a WebView bridge for rendering the Monaco Editor.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_monaco and material_ui to pubspec.yaml.
